scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Huh? Do I know you? It's creepy that you seem so familiar. You don't have a twin, do you?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
咦？我认识你吗？
你看起来好眼熟，真是让人毛骨悚然。
你该不会有个双胞胎吧？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What, do you want to be a Thief? I'm sorry, but you look like you need more training.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
什么，你想成为盗贼？
抱歉，你看起来还需要更多训练。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Take your time and learn all the Basic Skills, will you? Well then, see you later~!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
慢慢来，把基本技能都学会，好吗？
那么，下次再见啦~！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Well, I got this feeling like you've been through a lifetime of fighting, so I'm promoting you to a Thief right this minute. I better give you tough guys what you want...
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嗯，我有一种感觉，你仿佛已经经历了一生的战斗，所以我现在就晋升你为盗贼。我得给硬汉们他们想要的东西...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Since you've become a Thief, live as a Thief. Now, go for it! Next~
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
既然你成为了盗贼，就要像盗贼一样生活。
去吧！下一个~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, dude.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, baby~
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿，宝贝~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, dude.
...Hey! You look too goody-goody to want to be a Thief!! Now scram, I'm busy. Next!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿，伙计。
...嘿！你看起来太正经了，不像想当盗贼的样子！！
快走吧，我很忙。下一个！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, baby.
...Hey! You look too goody-goody to want to be a Thief!! Now scram, I'm busy. Next!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿，宝贝。
...嘿！你看起来太正经了，不像想当盗贼的样子！！
快走吧，我很忙。下一个！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
If you have a problem, feel free to speak to me anytime, alright?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
如果你有问题，随时可以来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Huh.
Now, that's
a big sword.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
天哪...？
咦。
这把剑
真大啊。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
What's a Mage doin' here? Shouldn't you be doing card tricks elsewhere? Oh well, it's a free country...
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
天哪...？
一个魔法师在这里干什么？
你不应该去别处变魔术吗？
算了，这是自由的国家...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
You're a Merchant,
right? Why are you
walking into a den
of Thieves?!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
天哪...？
你是商人，
对吧？
为什么你要走进
盗贼的巢穴？！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Oh my God...
Am I dying?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
天哪...？
天哪...
我是不是要死了？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Didn't you use to be one of us?! Man, you changed. You seem real dangerous now...
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
天哪...？
你以前不是我们中的一员吗？！
天哪，你变了。你现在看起来很危险...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Man, you got real cool all of a sudden! You must have some skills I can only dream of!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
天哪...？
天哪，你突然变得很酷！
你一定有我梦寐以求的技能！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
天哪...？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Man, shouldn't you
Archers be playing
in the forest
or something?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
天哪...？
天哪，你们弓箭手
不应该在森林里
玩耍什么的吗？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
You know we all steal for a living, right? What are you doing in this kinda place, Acolyte?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
天哪...？
你知道我们都是以偷窃为生的，对吧？
你这种服事来这里干什么？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
So...
Trying to make
up for something
...Buddy?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
所以...
你想弥补什么
...巴迪？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Oh wait,
it's not...
Get outta here!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
哦等等，
不是...
快滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
It's like you're begging
us to steal from you!
Come on, hurry and
get outta here~
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
你简直是在求我们偷你！
行了，赶紧滚出去~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Why else would a Priest come here? I guess I better start confessing all of my misdeeds.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
牧师来这里还能有什么好事？看来我得赶紧忏悔我所有的罪行了。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
*Sigh* Look, there's really no need for you to be in this kind of place. You oughta go where you ought to go.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
*叹气* 听着，你根本不需要待在这种地方。你应该去你该去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hmmm?
You gathered Mushrooms for
the Thief test, right?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嗯？
你是为了盗贼测试
去采蘑菇了吧？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Here, talk to the other guy right next to me. He's the one in charge of checking your Mushrooms.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
去吧，跟我旁边那个人说话。他负责检查你的蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
So how was the
Mushroom Farm?
Have any fun?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
那么，蘑菇农场
怎么样？
玩得开心吗？

scripts.text: Yeah, kinda Cool.
scripts.translation: 是啊，挺酷的。

scripts.text: It was horrible.
scripts.translation: 太糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Heh heh! That's a good attitude. In our line of work, you gotta enjoy getting your hands dirty, one way or another.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿嘿！态度不错。在我们这行，你得享受弄脏双手的感觉，无论以何种方式。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Yeah? I've been there too, so I can see why that place isn't everyone's cup of tea. Still, being a Thief isn't all glamour and trendy night life.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
是吗？我也去过那里，所以我知道为什么那地方不是每个人都喜欢的。不过，当盗贼也不全是光鲜亮丽的夜生活。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, whaddya doin' here? Aren't you supposed to be gathering Mushrooms? Or did you need it explained to you again?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
嘿，你在这儿干嘛？不是应该去采蘑菇吗？还是说你需要我再解释一遍？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, that's okay.
scripts.translation: 不，没关系。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
*Sigh* Well, there's always one in the bunch. Alright, listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
*叹气* 总是会有这样的人。好吧，仔细听着。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, for your test, you gotta steal Mushrooms from a farm. Don't worry, the guy who owns the farm deserves to be robbed.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
好了，为了你的测试，你得从农场偷蘑菇。别担心，农场的主人活该被偷。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Anyway, you gotta gather two kinds of Mushrooms: ^0000FFOrange Net Mushrooms^000000 and ^0000FFOrange Gooey Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
总之，你得采集两种蘑菇：^0000FF毒香菇^000000和^0000FF恶臭香菇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Be careful, since there are monsters are the farm that are there to protect the Mushrooms. So this will be no walk in the park.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
小心点，农场里有保护蘑菇的魔物。所以这可不是件轻松的事。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
When you come back here after gathering Mushrooms, you'll be graded on the Mushrooms you've collected.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
当你采完蘑菇回来这里时，我们会根据你采集的蘑菇进行评分。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Each Orange Net Mushroom gets you 3 points, and you get 1 point for each Orange Gooey Mushroom. You need a total of 25 points to pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
每颗毒香菇得3分，每颗恶臭香菇得1分。你需要总共25分才能通过测试。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Go outside and keep going ahead toward the Eastern Field of the Pyramids. Then you will see one of our comrades between two columns.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
走到外面，继续朝金字塔东边的田野前进。然后你会看到我们的同志站在两根柱子之间。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Speak to that guy, and he'll take you to the farm through the backdoor.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
和那个人对话，他会带你从后门进入农场。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
On that field, I think his coordinates are '^FF0000141, 125^000000.' Just type ^3355FF/where^000000 in the right side of your chat box to check your present coordinates.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
在那片田野上，我觉得他的坐标是'^FF0000141, 125^000000'。在聊天框右侧输入^3355FF/where^000000即可查看当前坐标。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Huh. For a second there, I thought you had something really important to tell me.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
啊...刚才一瞬间，我还以为你有什么重要的事要告诉我呢。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What brings you down
here to this rathole?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
是什么风把你吹到
这个老鼠洞来了？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Ah...
You came back.
Are you sure you're
ready to try again?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
啊...
你回来了。
确定要再试一次吗？

scripts.text: Hey, I came here to be a Thief!
scripts.translation: 嘿，我来这里是为了成为盗贼！

scripts.text: Nah, I'm just looking around.
scripts.translation: 不，我只是随便逛逛。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Heh, I like your confidence. Still, you know being a Thief isn't all what it's cracked up to be.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
呵，我喜欢你的自信。不过，你知道当盗贼并不像外界吹捧的那样光鲜。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Still...
Do you really
want to be
a Thief?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
但是...
你真的想成为
盗贼吗？

scripts.text: Yeah.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No, just wasting your time.
scripts.translation: 不，只是浪费你的时间。

scripts.text: Why did you become a Thief?
scripts.translation: 你为什么成为盗贼？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Really...
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Yeah...
I can see that.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
是啊...
我看出来了。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Me...?
I had no choice at the time. It was either steal or starve. But it's not like I need to give you my life story.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
我...？
当时我别无选择。要么偷窃，要么饿死。但这可不是我要给你讲我的生平故事。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
So do you want to
apply to become
a Thief or not?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
那么，你是想申请成为
盗贼，还是不想？

scripts.text: Yes, I will.
scripts.translation: 是的，我愿意。

scripts.text: I'm too scared to be a Thief!
scripts.translation: 我太害怕当盗贼了！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, tell
me your name.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
好吧，告诉我你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
{0}?
What kind of name is {1}? Anyway, give me a second.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
{0}？
{1}是个什么名字？总之，请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, your registration has been processed. Okay, you can begin your test if you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
好的，你的注册已经处理完毕。如果你准备好了，可以开始测试了。

scripts.text: Yeah, I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 是的，我准备好了。

scripts.text: No, I'm not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 不，我还没准备好。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Not ready?
How can you
not be ready?!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
还没准备好？
你怎么可能
还没准备好？！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Too scared?!?
Hahahahahahah!
Oh, please...!
That's hilarious!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
太害怕了？！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
拜托...！
这也太好笑了！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Okay...
Give me
one second.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
好吧...
给我
一秒钟。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Your name is...
{0}? Um, where is it? Ah, here it is. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
你的名字是...
{0}？嗯，在哪里呢？啊，在这里。让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Isn't that cute? I can see you're ambitious, but you gotta learn all of the Basic Skills before you can become a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
真可爱啊。看得出你很有野心，但在成为盗贼之前，你必须学会所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright. I looked at your Felony Record, and you seem to have a very interesting history. You might have what it takes to be a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
好的。我看了你的犯罪记录，你的经历似乎很有趣。你可能有成为盗贼的潜质。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Because I feel like it, I now decree that you have passed this interview. Good work!
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
因为我觉得可以，所以我现在宣布你通过了这次面试。干得好！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Now, your actual abilities will need to be tested. Do you know anything about the test?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
现在，你的实际能力需要接受测试。你知道测试的内容吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text: Sorry, I don't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不知道。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Oh yeah? Well, this makes things a lot easier.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
哦是吗？那事情就简单多了。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, let me inform you then. Listen carefully. This test decides if you are worthy of becoming a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
好的，让我来告诉你。仔细听好。这次测试将决定你是否配得上成为盗贼。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
You will be sneaking to Shibu's Farm. He is the worst Merchant, in terms of character, in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
你要潜入西布斯的农场。他是莫洛克的商人中，人品最差的一个。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Alright, for your test, you gotta steal Mushrooms from his farm. Don't worry, that guy deserves to be robbed.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
好了，作为你的测试，你必须从他的农场偷蘑菇。别担心，那家伙活该被偷。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Anyway, you gotta gather two kinds of Mushrooms: ^0000FFOrange Net Mushrooms^000000 and ^0000FFOrange Gooey Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
总之，你得采集两种蘑菇：^0000FF毒香菇^000000和^0000FF恶臭香菇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Be careful, since there are monsters are the farm that are there to protect the Mushrooms. So this will be no walk in the park.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
小心点，农场里有保护蘑菇的魔物。所以这可不是件轻松的事。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
When you come back here after gathering Mushrooms, you'll be graded on the Mushrooms you've collected.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
当你采完蘑菇回来这里时，我们会根据你采集的蘑菇进行评分。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Each Orange Net Mushroom gets you 3 points, and you get 1 point for each Orange Gooey Mushroom. You need a total of 25 points to pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
每颗毒香菇得3分，每颗恶臭香菇得1分。你需要总共25分才能通过测试。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Go outside and keep going ahead toward the Eastern Field of the Pyramids. Then you will see one of our comrades between two columns.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
走到外面，继续朝金字塔东边的田野前进。然后你会看到我们的同志站在两根柱子之间。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Speak to that guy, and he'll take you to the farm through the backdoor.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
和那个人对话，他会带你从后门进入农场。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
On that field, I think his coordinates are '^FF0000141, 125^000000.' Just type ^3355FF/where^000000 in the right side of your chat box to check your present coordinates.
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
在那片田野上，我觉得他的坐标是'^FF0000141, 125^000000'。在聊天框右侧输入^3355FF/where^000000即可查看当前坐标。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Don't forget to make plans and prepare yourself before you go inside the Mushroom Farm. Move as quickly as you can and try not to get killed, alright?
scripts.translation:
[盗贼向导]
别忘了在进入蘑菇农场之前做好计划和准备。尽可能快地行动，并尽量不要被杀，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Brad]
We don't have any special events yet. Come some other time when there's news, alright?
scripts.translation:
[布拉德]
我们目前还没有任何特别活动。等有新消息的时候再来吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Um...
You don't look
like a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
嗯...
你看起来
不像个盗贼。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
What the heck are
you doing here anyway?
scripts.translation:
[同志]
你在这里
到底干什么？

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
What's the matter? If you want to be a Thief, speak to the girl beside me.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
怎么了？如果你想成为盗贼，去和我旁边的那个女孩对话。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Did you pass the interview?
Then what are you waiting for?
scripts.translation:
[同志]
你通过面试了吗？
那你在等什么？

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Ah, the guide told me about you. So, let me check your mushrooms...
scripts.translation:
[同志]
啊，向导跟我提起过你。那么，让我检查一下你的蘑菇...

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
What the hell...
You don't have any Mushrooms at all! Go back and get them. Otherwise, you won't pass the test and become a Thief!
scripts.translation:
[同志]
该死...
你竟然一个蘑菇都没有！回去再采一些。否则，你无法通过测试成为盗贼！

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
First, let me check the Orange Net Mushrooms you got.
Huh, {0} of them.
Now I'll just check your Orange Gooey Mushrooms. That's {1} you gathered.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
首先，让我检查一下你采的毒香菇。
嗯，有{0}个。
现在我来看看你的恶臭香菇。你一共采了{1}个。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Now I'll just check your Orange Gooey Mushrooms. That's {0} you gathered.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
现在我来看看你的恶臭香菇。你一共采了{0}个。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
First, let me check the Orange Net Mushrooms you got.
Huh, {0} of them.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
首先，让我检查一下你采的毒香菇。
嗯，有{0}个。

scripts.text: [Comrade]
scripts.translation: [同志]

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
So that would
bring your total to...
scripts.translation:
[同志]
那么，你的总分应该是...

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Hmmm. {0} degrees, multiplied by the speed of light, divided by the integral of pi times height plus the absolute value of politics...
scripts.translation:
[同志]
嗯。{0}度，乘以光速，除以π乘以高度加上政治绝对值的积分...

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Okay!
I got it.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
好了！
我算出来了。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Definitely less than the 25 points you need to pass. Go out there and get me more Mushrooms!
scripts.translation:
[同志]
肯定低于通过所需的25分。去外面给我多采点蘑菇！

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
You got more
than 25 points!
Awesome!
scripts.translation:
[同志]
你超过了25分！
太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Exactly 25 points!
You did it! Badass!
scripts.translation:
[同志]
正好25分！
你做到了！真厉害！

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
{0}...
You have passed the official Thief Test. You are now one of us.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
{0}...
你通过了正式的盗贼测试。现在，你也是我们的一员了。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
Congratulations on becoming a Thief! From now, be an honorable representative of the Thief's Guild.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
恭喜你成为盗贼！从现在开始，请作为盗贼公会的荣誉代表行事。

scripts.text:
[Comrade]
If you bring disgrace to our guild, you will be killed. I expect you to bring our comrades pride.
scripts.translation:
[同志]
如果你给公会带来耻辱，你会被处死。我期待你能为我们的同志带来荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Brad]
*Ahem* Welcome to the Guild, comrade! I'm Brad, and I'm in charge of human resources here.
scripts.translation:
[布拉德]
*咳* 欢迎加入公会，同志！我是布拉德，这里负责人力资源。

scripts.text:
[Brad]
Here is a small subsidy for a Newbie like you. Spend it whereever you want. Alright then, I'll see you around~
scripts.translation:
[布拉德]
这是给像你这样的新人的小额补贴。你想怎么花就怎么花。那么，回头见~

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Ah, I see that you are now a Thief. I always knew you'd join us.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
啊，看来你现在已经是盗贼了。我一直知道你会加入我们。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Stealing from a Mushroom farm is too easy for you now. You should build up your skills and master our craft.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
从蘑菇农场偷东西对你来说太简单了。你应该磨练技艺，精通我们的手艺。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
I could use a good, hard drink.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
我想来杯好酒，好好喝一顿。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Gimme your money.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
把你的钱交出来。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
WHO YOU CALLING A PSYCHO?!?!
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
谁是你说的疯子？！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
I've got nothing to say to you. Would you mind leaving me alone?
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
我没什么话想跟你说。你能不能别缠着我？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Today looks like a good day to go to the pyramids and hunt with some of my friends.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
今天看起来是个好日子，适合去金字塔和朋友们一起打怪。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Kidding, I'm off the clock.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
开玩笑的，我现在下班了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Hahahahaha~!
You haven't
passed the test yet?
Alright, I'll let you in...
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
哈哈哈哈哈~！
你还没通过测试吗？
好吧，我让你进去...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Hmm...
You've come to take the test, right? I can see in your eyes that you know something.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
嗯...
你是来接受测试的吧？我从你的眼神里看出你知道些什么。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Your name is {0}? Ah, it's on the list. Alright, I'll let you into the Mushroom Farm , but I can't guarantee your safety...
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
你的名字是{0}？啊，在名单上。好吧，我让你进入蘑菇农场，但我不能保证你的安全...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
There is this strange smell coming from... You. Now why would that be?
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
有一股奇怪的味道从...你身上散发出来。这到底是为什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
Hey Novice! Why don't you join the ranks of the Thief Guild? You newbies are always welcome to join us and our selfish cause.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
嘿，初心者！为什么不加入盗贼公会的行列呢？我们随时欢迎新人加入，为了我们自私的目标。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Irrelevant]
You can get more information in the Underground Room in the Pyramid 1 BF.
scripts.translation:
[无关先生]
你可以在金字塔1层地下室的房间里获取更多信息。
